Hi everyone, 

I am having major issues trying to import a dataset. 

When I have uploaded my dataset and specified which columns are the Region>Line Transect>Observations etc the wizard tries to import this data but produces errors and only imports a small fraction of my data, if any at all. 

The error is: 
"Error in line 1 importing a column from the 'Observation' layer
~Failed to add data to layer"
... 
... to many errors import aborted

Does anyone have any ideas? 

I have tried 
-using both txt/csv files
-removing NAs
-replacing NAs with blank cell

Thanks,
Fay

Updated:

Possible solution (courtesy of Eric)
  • tried to import the csv file, ignoring most of the data fields
    • resulted in the error you reported a week ago "Error line 1, observation layer..."
    • but there were a few records created in the data sheet, although they didn't contain proper information
  • without closing DistWin, I simply repeated the same importing steps and this time all went fine.
    • no altering of the data file, just duplicating the import, overwriting what was there previously.
Import then completed successfully.  

Don't have an explanation for the failure on the first attempt and success on the second without changing anything...

would be curious to know if anyone ever experiences this also. 

Thanks,
